summary: This is an 8-K filed by SS Innovations International, Inc. announcing a milestone of over 10,500 cumulative surgeries performed with its SSi Mantra surgical robotic system as of April 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release detailing the achievement, with specific counts of cardiac, telesurgery, and pediatric procedures, as well as physician training and system installations across 11 countries. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation event is described. The filing is a routine operational update under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, or any other special-situation category.
